checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan: meridian, a zero-dependency static time zone meeting planner for GitHub Pages. [1/5] Node scaffold (package.json, index.html, styles, serve+dogfood scripts, core skeleton, first tests). [2/5] Core engine: IANA zone model, 24h local-hour grid, work-hour categories, overlap and best-slot ranking, URL state codec, ICS export. [3/5] UI: participants editor, timeline grid, slot picker, share link, copy summary. [4/5] Accessibility, CSP and hygiene hardening, README final. [5/5] Full Phase 4 gates and ledger wrap-up.

impact_assessment.why: The AegeanWorks portfolio has no time zone tool; a fully client-side meeting planner fills that gap and deploys on GitHub Pages with zero build step.
impact_assessment.benefits: A useful, offline, privacy-preserving scheduler for distributed teams; a new deployable static product for the org with a Node-tested core.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none (new project); dependency: none (zero-dependency, Intl API in browser and Node 20+); concurrency: none (single-user client state); state: URL hash state must round-trip losslessly or shared links break.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep all timezone math in a pure src/core module covered by node --test; encode state as compact JSON with a schema version; test round-trip and ICS output byte-exactly.

checkpoints.description: [2/5] Core engine landed: Intl-only wall-clock/offset math with DST gap and ambiguity rules, IANA catalog with curated fallback and ranked search, 24-hour day grid with per-person work hours (wrap-around shifts), overlap columns, best-window ranking, slot quality, URL-hash codec with defensive decoding, and RFC 5545 ICS export with escaping and octet folding. 5 Node suites, 47 tests, all passing in ~0.3s.

handoff.next: build the UI (grid, panel, bootstrap, styles, index.html)

checkpoints.description: [3/5] Static UI landed: dark Aegean stylesheet, index.html with strict CSP, timeline grid with category colours, overlap bands, now marker, pointer drag and arrow-key selection; participant panel with live clocks, work-hour selects and zone validation; bootstrap wiring plan/slot state and the hash; clipboard helper with legacy fallback. Recorded has_ui=yes (kind web) and adopted the UI contract via fix (.aikit/ui.json).

handoff.state: gates not yet re-run after UI

checkpoints.description: [4/5] Browser dogfood pass added (headless Edge/Chrome over CDP): default plan, add/remove people, drag selection across rows, keyboard nudge, best slot, share hash, calendar download, reference zone, date stepper, pasted links; README rewritten with prerequisites, commands, features, accessibility, tree and deploy notes; hygiene fixes for third-party links (documented footer exception, relative test bases).

[5/5] Phase 4 verified after fix: 4/4 gates pass (test 47/47, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); dogfood [OK]; README tree matches tracked files; UI contract adopted. checklists: passed. Uncommitted: commit not authorized (PRINCIPLE-018 R1); delivery warnings remain for the UI task record and publishing, both user-authorized steps.

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Add the missing Reset control the remove-error message already told users to press; it restores the two-zone example for today in the current reference zone and clears the slot. Harden the dogfood calendar-download wait into a poll after one flaky run, and cover Reset in the dogfood pass. checklists: passed. Gates 4/4, tests 47/47.

impact_assessment.why: The UI told users to press Reset, but no such control existed.
impact_assessment.benefits: Removes a dead-end error path and gives a one-click way back to the demo state.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: reset must not change the reference zone or leave a stale slot.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reset reuses defaultPlan in the current zone and nulls the slot; dogfood asserts participants, rows, date sync, cleared slot and updated hash.
